quote: With Jacobs, we have had a lot of higher-level engineering support than our previous operator which has helped the City. speaker: Vince Carroccia

quote: One of the value-added qualities of Jacobs is the maintenance program. speaker: Richard Lewis

quote: As the City of Vancouver’s professional service O&M provider, Jacobs is a true partner and one that shares the same mission and vision to provide excellent customer service, quality work and a deep appreciation for protecting the community and the environment.
